scope: Read-only full semantic, mathematical, formal, and Classical-Arabic source review of OLP-0501 through OLP-0600 against the frozen English source and frozen/current MSA; only this review JSON/Markdown pair was created. No source, configuration, TeX, Git, publication, or state-log mutation.

authority_snapshot.role: immutable unit order and frozen English/MSA identities

method.semantic_reading: Every one of the 100 pinned English files, frozen/current MSA files, and current Classical targets was read in source form. Definitions, hypotheses, negations, quantifier scope, formulas, references, proof steps, examples, exercises, quotations, and editorial qualifications were compared as applicable.
method.independence: Batch authoring receipts and retrospective term ledgers were not treated as semantic proof. Current source bytes and the governing contracts control this disposition.
method.classical_style_test: Applied STYLE_SPEC: native scholarly flow, explicit logical transitions, faithful qualifications, and restrained historical register without ornamental archaism or English syntax tracing.
method.formal_comparison: Compared mathematical carriers and proof reasoning, while separating target defects, inherited English/MSA defects, and target-side repairs of frozen-source errors.
method.static_check: Ran python -B build/validate_classical_overlay.py --ids 501-600 --json without TeX. It returned INCOMPLETE/2 only because semantic review and structural assertions are external to that invocation: 94 changed-prose-awaiting-semantic-review and 6 unchanged-prose. All 100 frozen/current English and MSA identities matched; every environment, reference/key, import, literal block, proof-command, terminology-inventory, and ordered formula-token check was true; no unit failure was emitted.
method.meaning_of_pass: PASS means no additional source-level semantic or Classical-style defect was found in the exact three-way bytes. It is not a render/bidi result, a dictionary attestation, or machine-checked proof certification.

verification.formula_invariant_note: Static MSA→Classical carrier checks are all green. They do not detect inherited formal errors (for example 0595-I1) or Classical prose that changes mathematical force (for example 0588-N1).

findings.proposed_minimal_repair: Fix j once it is eligible. While j remains eligible, every selected i(m) is ≤j; after selection that index is permanently ineligible because a disjunct is added. Only finitely many indices ≤j exist, so j is selected after finitely many further stages.

findings.proposed_minimal_repair: Argue directly: if β∈ω, then β+1∈ω by closure of the natural numbers under successor, contradicting that α is infinite. Hence β is infinite; then invoke ordinfinitycharacter.

findings.issue: The Classical proof says «كل f:α→β» induces the product map and that this suffices. An arbitrary function does not witness equinumerosity of the products; the hypothesis supplies a bijection, and bijectivity of the induced map must be used.
